cases.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.

findings: Normal versus empty reasoning: SA3.250 versus3.000,+.250(5wins10ties1loss,CI[0,.5]); PC3.625 versus3.9375,-.3125(0wins11ties5losses,CI[-.5625,-.125]). Passes7/8/6 versus3/11/3.

PC losses004/015/025/026/038 are each1point. Only025/038 also gainSA;004/015/026 incurPC loss with unchangedSA. Thus PC losses cannot all be interpreted as a necessary price of better process execution.
SA gains010/018/025/034/038; loss017. Jointgains010/018/034/038,loss015. Correct reasoning helps some requested processes but does not jointly improve physical stability.

VP015 is SA4 under both normal andempty, whilePC drops4to3 withnormal reasoning. Its normal-versusR1 SA increase is not evidence that the extra reasoning text is needed for that SA gain; co-trained model behavior also changes.

Empty retains own image/request contextual Qwen features, explicit request reader, nativeT5 and negativeC. This is not a no-Qwen/no-physical-branch comparison. Both anchor and input-value output can change under the intervention.
Normal/no_c SA andPC means both3.250/3.625. PC2wins12ties2losses,CI[-.25,.25]; SA1win14ties1loss,CI[-.1875,.1875]. Joint is identical6/16 casewise.
Branch PC gains0022to3 and0173to4, both retained under emptyreasoning. Branch PC losses0154to3 and0275to4. SA+0153to4 (also retained underempty),-0173to2 (emptySA3).

All five normal/empty SA gains010/018/025/034/038 merely restore the same SA value already achieved with no_c. All four normal/empty Joint gains likewise restore no_c passes. This does not establish added execution benefit beyond the no_c intervention.

R9 andR9.1 no_c SA/PC ratings are identical on all16; normal branchPC effect drops+.250 to0. This locates observed score loss in the active-branch behavior on these inputs, while not asserting equal backbone weights or pixels.
Correct versus unrelated reasoning: normal3.250/3.625 versusunrelated3.3125/3.5625; PC+.0625(1win15ties0losses,CI[0,.1875]),SA-.0625(0wins15ties1loss,CI[-.1875,0]); Jointcasewiseunchanged6.

OnlyVP017 differs: unrelatedSA3/PC3 becomesnormalSA2/PC4. All other15cases have identical SA/PC ratings, not necessarily identical videos. Correct physical-text matching has only a narrow observed PC benefit with an SA cost on this fixed16.

The normal-versus-empty PC losses004/015/025/026/038 all retain the same normal score under unrelatedreasoning. The five normal-versus-emptySA gains likewise appear under unrelatedreasoning, and merely match no_c SA. This weakens a claim that those changes specifically use correct physical reasoning.

OldR9 correct/unrelated PC+.1875 withSA+.0625 andJoint4to6 is not retained byR9.1: its gap is onlyPC+.0625/SA-.0625 withJoint6unchanged. Absolute final40/60 and no_c controls still fail the requested benefit.
Shared-only(C_anchor+b)16 SA3.0625/PC3.625,passes5/7/5. AddingPZ givesSA+.1875(3wins13ties0losses,CI[0,.375]),PC0(2wins12ties2losses,CI[-.25,.25]),Joint5to6 solelyVP010.
PZ raisesPC0103to4 and0173to4, lowers0154to3 and0275to4; SA gains010/015/025. PC effects cancel; lower correctioncosine has not produced net physical gain.

Shared-only versus no_c: PC+002 and-010 net0; SA losses010/017/025. PZ restores010SA/PC and025SA, adds015SA with aPC loss, adds017PC without repairing itsSA loss, and creates027PC loss. Some positivePZ effects repair errors introduced by the remaining branch.

All six controls are now complete. Normal PC3.625 versus fixed train-mean C3.875: -0.250,1win11ties4losses,paired95interval[-.5625,.0625]; SA+.0625,2/13/1; Joint6 identical casewise. No normal content PC advantage established.

Mean-to-normal changes: VP0042/4->2/3;0153/5->4/3;0173/3->2/4;0252/3->3/3;0262/5->2/4;0274/5->4/4. PC losses004/026/027 have unchangedSA; the mean advantage is not entirely a consequence of sacrificing requested-process execution.

Fixed positive/negative means use64cached train inputs each. Positive RMS .081928 per-sample root-mean-square becomes .049550; negative .078631 becomes .041405. Content and amplitude change together. Fixed C can still yield state-dependent physical writes through native Wan state queries and state-value modulation; native text/image remain.
Anchor-only16 SA3.1875/PC3.625,passes5/7/5. Adding b+PZ: SA+.0625(2/13/1),PC0(2/12/2),Joint5->6 via010. No netPCgain from learned correction.

Shared b isolated by shared_only minusanchor: identicalPCall16; SA lossesVP0173->2 andVP0253->2, mean-.125; Jointunchanged5. b is not a successful replacement for the R1 composed Q-workspace correction.

Final400 PZ tokencosine .61096 and b+PZ .61742 versus R1 projectedU .99486. Reducedcollapse is real, but generationPC worsened. Restore useful execution capacity and distinguish semantic alignment/routing from physical values rather than optimize cosine.

Latest user steering: differentiated C is not an independent success target. Prioritize PC/SA and actual visual/process quality; useful shared physical priors are allowed. Controls diagnose contribution, not a demand for arbitrary diversity.

old_r9_no_c_score_equivalence.scope: Equality of existing evaluator ratings only, not identical videos/weights or an isolated trained-architecture counterfactual.

contrast_semantics.shared_only: Both CFG arms retain C_anchor+b and remove only PZ, with same co-trained enhancement/fusion/Wan weights; not a separately trained model or a constantC condition.
contrast_semantics.global_train_mean: Mean complete C at each slot/channel, including the input anchor, shared correction and Q-selected input-value correction. Fix positive and negative complete C separately; retain native T5, first image and gamma5. Changes content and amplitude together; not a pure semantic intervention.
contrast_semantics.anchor_only: Both CFG arms use own frozen input anchor only, removing b and PZ; same co-trained fusion/Wan weights.

shared_vs_anchor.scope: Existing scores only; no new generation/evaluator/bootstrap

anchor_vs_off.scope: Existing scores only; no new generation/evaluator/bootstrap
